name: SimpleGraph.Container.card_fingerprints
statement:
@[simp] theorem card_fingerprints (q : ℕ) :
    #(fingerprints (V := V) q) = (Fintype.card V).choose q

name: SimpleGraph.Container.mem_fingerprints
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_fingerprints {q : ℕ} {S : Finset V} :
    S ∈ fingerprints (V := V) q ↔ #S = q

name: SimpleGraph.Container.degreeWithin_eq_degree_induce
statement:
theorem degreeWithin_eq_degree_induce (A : Finset V) (v : A) :
    degreeWithin G A v = (G.induce (A : Set V)).degree v

name: SimpleGraph.Container.degreeWithin_le_maxDegreeVertex
statement:
theorem degreeWithin_le_maxDegreeVertex (A : Finset V) (hA : A.Nonempty) (v : V)
    (hv : v ∈ A) :
    degreeWithin G A v ≤ degreeWithin G A (maxDegreeVertex G A hA)

name: SimpleGraph.Container.degreeWithin_le_of_maxDegreeOrder_eq_append_cons
statement:
theorem degreeWithin_le_of_maxDegreeOrder_eq_append_cons
    (A : Finset V) {before suffix : List V} {v w : V}
    (horder : maxDegreeOrder G A = before ++ v :: suffix)
    (hw : w ∈ (v :: suffix).toFinset) :
    degreeWithin G (v :: suffix).toFinset w ≤
      degreeWithin G (v :: suffix).toFinset v

name: SimpleGraph.Container.length_maxDegreeOrder
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_maxDegreeOrder (A : Finset V) :
    (maxDegreeOrder G A).length = #A

name: SimpleGraph.Container.maxDegreeOrder_empty
statement: theorem maxDegreeOrder_empty : maxDegreeOrder G ∅ = []

name: SimpleGraph.Container.maxDegreeOrder_eq_nil_iff
statement:
theorem maxDegreeOrder_eq_nil_iff (A : Finset V) :
    maxDegreeOrder G A = [] ↔ A = ∅

name: SimpleGraph.Container.maxDegreeOrder_nodup
statement:
theorem maxDegreeOrder_nodup (A : Finset V) :
    (maxDegreeOrder G A).Nodup

name: SimpleGraph.Container.maxDegreeOrder_toFinset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem maxDegreeOrder_toFinset (A : Finset V) :
    (maxDegreeOrder G A).toFinset = A

name: SimpleGraph.Container.maxDegreeVertex_mem
statement:
theorem maxDegreeVertex_mem (A : Finset V) (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    maxDegreeVertex G A hA ∈ A

name: SimpleGraph.Container.beforeVertex_not_mem_of_firstIn_eq_some
statement:
theorem beforeVertex_not_mem_of_firstIn_eq_some
    {order : List V} {I : Finset V} {v w : V}
    (h : firstIn order I = some v) (hw : w ∈ beforeVertex order v) :
    w ∉ I

name: SimpleGraph.Container.card_fingerprint_le
statement:
theorem card_fingerprint_le (I : Finset V) (q : ℕ) :
    #(fingerprint G q I) ≤ q

name: SimpleGraph.Container.card_fingerprint_of_le_card
statement:
theorem card_fingerprint_of_le_card {I : Finset V} (hI : G.IsIndepSet I)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ #I) :
    #(fingerprint G q I) = q

name: SimpleGraph.Container.exists_eq_beforeVertex_append_of_firstIn_eq_some
statement:
theorem exists_eq_beforeVertex_append_of_firstIn_eq_some
    {order : List V} {I : Finset V} {v : V}
    (h : firstIn order I = some v) :
    ∃ after : List V, order = beforeVertex order v ++ v :: after

name: SimpleGraph.Container.fingerprint_isIndepSet
statement:
theorem fingerprint_isIndepSet {I : Finset V} (hI : G.IsIndepSet I) (q : ℕ) :
    G.IsIndepSet (fingerprint G q I)

name: SimpleGraph.Container.fingerprint_subset
statement:
theorem fingerprint_subset (I : Finset V) (q : ℕ) :
    fingerprint G q I ⊆ I

name: SimpleGraph.Container.fingerprint_union_sdiff
statement:
theorem fingerprint_union_sdiff (I : Finset V) (q : ℕ) :
    fingerprint G q I ∪ (I \ fingerprint G q I) = I

name: SimpleGraph.Container.firstIn_eq_some_mem
statement:
theorem firstIn_eq_some_mem {order : List V} {I : Finset V} {v : V}
    (h : firstIn order I = some v) : v ∈ order ∧ v ∈ I

name: SimpleGraph.Container.nextVertex_run_ne_none
statement:
theorem nextVertex_run_ne_none {I : Finset V} (hI : G.IsIndepSet I)
    {q k : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ #I) (hk : k < q) :
    nextVertex G I (run G I k).active ≠ none

name: SimpleGraph.Container.run_active_antitone
statement:
theorem run_active_antitone (I : Finset V) {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    (run G I k).active ⊆ (run G I j).active

name: SimpleGraph.Container.run_fingerprint_eq_run
statement:
theorem run_fingerprint_eq_run {I : Finset V} (hI : G.IsIndepSet I)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ #I) :
    run G (fingerprint G q I) q = run G I q

name: SimpleGraph.Container.run_selected_mono
statement:
theorem run_selected_mono (I : Finset V) {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    (run G I j).selected ⊆ (run G I k).selected

name: SimpleGraph.Container.run_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_succ (I : Finset V) (k : ℕ) :
    run G I (k + 1) = step G I (run G I k)

name: SimpleGraph.Container.run_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_zero (I : Finset V) : run G I 0 = State.initial

name: SimpleGraph.Container.sdiff_fingerprint_subset_activeAfter
SimpleGraph.Container.selected_disjoint_active
statement:
theorem selected_disjoint_active (I : Finset V) (q : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (fingerprint G q I) (activeAfter G q I)

name: SimpleGraph.Container.step_active_subset
statement:
theorem step_active_subset (I : Finset V) (state : State V) :
    (step G I state).active ⊆ state.active

name: SimpleGraph.Container.step_selected_mono
statement:
theorem step_selected_mono (I : Finset V) (state : State V) :
    state.selected ⊆ (step G I state).selected

name: SimpleGraph.Container.beta_mul_card_le_card_inter_discarded
statement:
theorem beta_mul_card_le_card_inter_discarded
    {β : ℝ} {R : ℕ} (hβ_one : β ≤ 1)
    (hdense : IsLocallyDense G β R) {I : Finset V} {state : State V} {v : V}
    (hnext : nextVertex G I state.active = some v)
    (hlarge : R < #(step G I state).active) :
    β * (#state.active : ℝ) ≤
      (#(state.active ∩ discarded G state.active v) : ℝ)

name: SimpleGraph.Container.beta_mul_card_sub_one_le_degreeWithin_maxDegreeVertex
statement:
theorem beta_mul_card_sub_one_le_degreeWithin_maxDegreeVertex
    {β : ℝ} {R : ℕ} (hdense : IsLocallyDense G β R)
    {A : Finset V} (hAR : R ≤ #A) (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    β * ((#A - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (degreeWithin G A (maxDegreeVertex G A hA) : ℝ)

name: SimpleGraph.Container.beta_mul_card_sub_one_le_degreeWithin_of_forall_le
statement:
theorem beta_mul_card_sub_one_le_degreeWithin_of_forall_le
    {β : ℝ} {R : ℕ} (hdense : IsLocallyDense G β R)
    {A : Finset V} {v : V} (hAR : R ≤ #A) (hv : v ∈ A)
    (hmax : ∀ w ∈ A, degreeWithin G A w ≤ degreeWithin G A v) :
    β * ((#A - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (degreeWithin G A v : ℝ)

name: SimpleGraph.Container.card_activeAfter_le
statement:
theorem card_activeAfter_le {β : ℝ} {R q : ℕ} (h : Hypotheses G β R q)
    {I : Finset V} (hI : G.IsIndepSet I) (hqI : q ≤ #I) :
    #(activeAfter G q I) ≤ R

name: SimpleGraph.Container.card_activeAfter_le_pow_mul_card
statement:
theorem card_activeAfter_le_pow_mul_card
    {β : ℝ} {R q : ℕ} (hβ_one : β ≤ 1)
    (hdense : IsLocallyDense G β R) {I : Finset V}
    (hI : G.IsIndepSet I) (hqI : q ≤ #I)
    (hlarge : R < #(activeAfter G q I)) :
    (#(activeAfter G q I) : ℝ) ≤
      (1 - β) ^ q * (Fintype.card V : ℝ)

name: SimpleGraph.Container.card_activeAfter_le_threshold_or_le_pow_mul_card
statement:
theorem card_activeAfter_le_threshold_or_le_pow_mul_card
    {β : ℝ} {R q : ℕ} (hβ_one : β ≤ 1)
    (hdense : IsLocallyDense G β R) {I : Finset V}
    (hI : G.IsIndepSet I) (hqI : q ≤ #I) :
    #(activeAfter G q I) ≤ R ∨
      (#(activeAfter G q I) : ℝ) ≤
        (1 - β) ^ q * (Fintype.card V : ℝ)

name: SimpleGraph.Container.card_step_active_le_one_sub_mul
statement:
theorem card_step_active_le_one_sub_mul
    {β : ℝ} {R : ℕ} (hβ_one : β ≤ 1)
    (hdense : IsLocallyDense G β R) {I : Finset V} {state : State V}
    (hprogress : nextVertex G I state.active ≠ none)
    (hlarge : R < #(step G I state).active) :
    (#(step G I state).active : ℝ) ≤ (1 - β) * (#state.active : ℝ)

name: SimpleGraph.Container.card_step_active_le_threshold_or_le_one_sub_mul
statement:
theorem card_step_active_le_threshold_or_le_one_sub_mul
    {β : ℝ} {R : ℕ} (hβ_one : β ≤ 1)
    (hdense : IsLocallyDense G β R) {I : Finset V} {state : State V}
    (hprogress : nextVertex G I state.active ≠ none) :
    #(step G I state).active ≤ R ∨
      (#(step G I state).active : ℝ) ≤ (1 - β) * (#state.active : ℝ)

name: SimpleGraph.Container.exists_average_le_degreeWithin
statement:
theorem exists_average_le_degreeWithin {A : Finset V} (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    ∃ v ∈ A,
      2 * inducedEdgeCount G A ≤ #A * degreeWithin G A v

name: SimpleGraph.Container.one_sub_pow_le_exp_neg_mul
statement:
theorem one_sub_pow_le_exp_neg_mul {β : ℝ} (hβ_one : β ≤ 1) (q : ℕ) :
    (1 - β) ^ q ≤ Real.exp (-β * (q : ℝ))

name: SimpleGraph.Container.sum_degreeWithin_eq_twice_inducedEdgeCount
statement:
theorem sum_degreeWithin_eq_twice_inducedEdgeCount (A : Finset V) :
    (∑ v ∈ A, degreeWithin G A v) = 2 * inducedEdgeCount G A

name: SimpleGraph.Container.twice_inducedEdgeCount_le_card_mul_degreeWithin_of_forall_le
statement:
theorem twice_inducedEdgeCount_le_card_mul_degreeWithin_of_forall_le
    {A : Finset V} {v : V}
    (hmax : ∀ w ∈ A, degreeWithin G A w ≤ degreeWithin G A v) :
    2 * inducedEdgeCount G A ≤ #A * degreeWithin G A v

name: SimpleGraph.Container.card_containerFamily_le
statement:
theorem card_containerFamily_le (q : ℕ) :
    #(containerFamily G q) ≤ (Fintype.card V).choose q

name: SimpleGraph.Container.containerFamily_isContainerFamily
SimpleGraph.Container.fingerprint_certificate
statement:
theorem fingerprint_certificate {β : ℝ} {R q : ℕ}
    (h : Hypotheses G β R q)
    {I : Finset V} (hI : G.IsIndepSet I) (hqI : q ≤ #I) :
    IsCertificate q R I
      (fingerprint G q I)
      (remainder G q (fingerprint G q I))

name: SimpleGraph.Container.graph_container_theorem
statement:
theorem graph_container_theorem {β : ℝ} {R q : ℕ}
    (h : Hypotheses G β R q) :
    ∃ 𝒞 : Finset (Finset V),
      #𝒞 ≤ (Fintype.card V).choose q ∧
        IsContainerFamily G R q 𝒞

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.card_vertex
statement: theorem card_vertex : Fintype.card (Vertex n k) = vertexCount n k

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.graph_adj_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem graph_adj_iff {A B : Vertex n k} :
    (graph n k).Adj A B ↔
      A ≠ B ∧ Disjoint (A : Finset (Fin n)) (B : Finset (Fin n))

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.graph_adj_iff_disjoint
statement:
theorem graph_adj_iff_disjoint (hk : 0 < k) {A B : Vertex n k} :
    (graph n k).Adj A B ↔ Disjoint (A : Finset (Fin n)) (B : Finset (Fin n))

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.intersectingFamilyCount_pos
statement: theorem intersectingFamilyCount_pos (n k : ℕ) : 0 < intersectingFamilyCount n k

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.isIntersecting_iff_isIndepSet
statement:
theorem isIntersecting_iff_isIndepSet (hk : 0 < k) (𝒜 : Finset (Vertex n k)) :
    IsIntersecting n k 𝒜 ↔ (graph n k).IsIndepSet 𝒜

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.mem_intersectingFamilies
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_intersectingFamilies {𝒜 : Finset (Vertex n k)} :
    𝒜 ∈ intersectingFamilies n k ↔ IsIntersecting n k 𝒜
